intro.text: A deadeye spren whom Ico, a Reacher, calls his father; his Radiant broke their oaths long ago.

items.text: Ico kept him locked in the hold of his ship in Shadesmar so he wouldn't wander off looking for the human who carried his Shardblade in the Physical Realm. His fate left Ico doubting that a human like Adolin could truly care for a deadeye spren.
